summary: Fortress Net Lease REIT filed an 8-K announcing a credit facility upsize. FNLR OP LP, as borrower, with the REIT and subsidiaries as guarantors, executed a New Lender Joinder Agreement dated September 29, 2026 with Associated Bank, N.A., which joined the August 13, 2024 credit agreement as a lender. Aggregate commitments rose from $1.95 billion to $1.98 billion, with the revolver increasing from $1.585 billion to $1.60 billion and the term loan from $365 million to $380 million. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation; watch for incremental acquisition capacity.
